
```{r}
my_csv <- read.csv("prac4_data/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv") # CSV Non Spatial Data 
world_countries <- st_read("prac4_data/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson") #Spatial Data - Vector
st_layers("prac4_data/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson") # meta data about the layers

```
```{r}
plot(st_geometry(world_countries)) # Previewing the empty map, could be done in QGIS too))
```
```{r}
world_countries # previewing the geojson file
```
```{r}
my_csv # previewing the non spatial data
```

```{r}
clean_csv <- my_csv %>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>%
  mutate(diff_2019_2010 = gii_2019 - gii_2010) %>%
  filter(!is.na(diff_2019_2010)) 

clean_csv #previewing the new csv with the selected columns
```

```{r}
# performing the join

final_map <- world_countries |> 
  left_join(clean_csv, by = c("COUNTRY" = "country"))  # by c("geo id" = "csv id")

final_map # Result !!
```
